collection.description: A teen's berry dye turns friends' hair a startling shade of green.

premise.name: The premise
premise.text: A teenager volunteers to dye friends' hair with berry pigment. The color turns a startling shade of green.

a.name: Answer A
a.text: The hairstyle becomes a brief fashion trend.

text_only.reason: rule 9: no head is green, and the trend is brief

b.name: Answer B
b.text: The dye fades unevenly; everyone laughs except the very particular apprentice.

c.name: Answer C
c.text: A new look sticks, and the teen discovers an unexpected talent for hairdressing.
